climate_water_notes.note: The province has diverse climates including mountainous, desert/semi-desert in the south, and cold mountainous in high areas. The annual average temperature is 13.3°C. January is the coldest month (min 1.5°C) and July is the hottest month (max 24.7°C). Cold Siberian air masses affect autumn and spring, while hot and dry air masses affect summer.
